description: Source code for DraftService class managing draft data product packages, including creation, retrieval, and listing of drafts with database interactions and audit logging.

classes.name: DraftService
classes.description: Service class for managing the lifecycle of draft data product packages, including creation, retrieval, and listing functionalities.

methods.name: create_draft
methods.description: Creates a new draft data product package, assigns versioning, and records an audit event.

methods.name: get_draft
methods.description: Retrieves a draft by its ID, including its package details.

methods.name: list_drafts
methods.description: Lists all drafts, optionally filtered by user ID.
